description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable and its effect on the output of git rev-parse --show-prefix. It defines test functions, sets environment variables, creates directories, and performs assertions to verify behavior.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Defines a test that checks if the output of 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' matches the expected prefix string.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Defines a test that expects a failure with a specific error code when running 'git rev-parse --show-prefix'.
